# Hex Compiler (CyberWitches)

> A browser-based idle/incremental game where you compile fading magic into hexadecimal code.

Hex Compiler is an idle/clicker game, published in the CyberWitches repository, that runs entirely in the browser. You play one of the last Hex Compilers, translating magical hexes into hexadecimal code and building digital preservation chambers to fight the fading of magic. Built in vanilla JavaScript (ES2023 modules) with no runtime framework, bundled with esbuild, and shipped as an installable Progressive Web App. The deliberately glitched UI progressively stabilizes as you preserve more magic — the interface itself is part of the story.

## Product thesis
- Design tiers (0–4): UI heals from broken mono terminal to full chrome.
- Tier advance = SYSTEM_RESTORE ceremony (mute-readable); SHARE_RESTORE exports a sanitized split still + text (no full save secrets).
- Single compile-goal rail after tutorial (not dual quest HUD).
- Local-only funnel keys `cw.funnel.*` (TTA/TTH/share); no remote analytics by default.
- Canonical remote: Forgejo git.kyanitelabs.tech (GitHub is mirror).

## Tech
- Vanilla JavaScript (ES2023 modules), esbuild, installable PWA, Tone.js audio. MIT licensed.
- Heal modules: `js/modules/game/healCeremony.js`, `healCapture.js`, `healShare.js`, `funnelMetrics.js`, `designTierSystem.js`.

## Run
- `npm install`, then `npm start` (dev server on http://localhost:3000); `npm run build:prod` for static output.
- Tests: `npm run ci`; heal e2e: `npx playwright test e2e/heal-operator-journeys.spec.js`.
